description: This file contains unit tests for the UserSettings plugin within a WPEFramework-based project. It verifies getting and setting user preferences via JSON-RPC and COM-RPC interfaces, subscribes to various user settings change events, and includes mock classes for event handling. The tests ensure that the plugin correctly interacts with persistent storage, triggers notifications, and maintains expected default and updated values for user settings.
